svg.text: One radius system, one accent, one set of haptics, used by every screen.
Follows your phone, or pick one
Real tokens from the app: Apple-style system colours
Light mode keeps the same roles: accent #007AFF, surfaces #F2F2F7 and #FFFFFF.
12 haptic events, every one routed through a single place so the feel is the same everywhere
